user.title: Configure SMN Argentina
user.description: Pick how to connect. Direct SMN works out of the box with no server. The OpenSMN proxy is for advanced users who self-host it.

proxy.title: Connect to OpenSMN proxy
proxy.description: Enter your self-hosted OpenSMN address. Use the LAN IP if Home Assistant runs on another machine (localhost only works when OpenSMN runs on the same host). The password must match PASSWORD in the OpenSMN .env file; leave it empty if OpenSMN has none.

direct.title: Connect directly to SMN
direct.description: Leave the token empty to fetch it automatically. If automatic fetch fails (SMN sometimes blocks it), paste your token: open {smn_site} in your browser, press F12, go to Application > Local Storage and copy the value of 'token'.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SMN Argentina
reauth_confirm.description: Update the OpenSMN password (must match PASSWORD in the OpenSMN .env file).

data.opensmn_password: OpenSMN password (leave empty if OpenSMN has none)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach SMN. Check the network and try again.
error.cannot_connect_proxy: Could not reach the OpenSMN proxy. Is OpenSMN running at that URL? If Home Assistant runs on another machine, use the LAN IP instead of localhost.
error.cannot_connect_direct: Could not reach SMN directly. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the OpenSMN password and try again.
error.invalid_token: That doesn't look like an SMN token. It should start with 'eyJ' and have 3 parts separated by dots.
error.location_not_found: No SMN station found for these coordinates. Try a nearby city.
error.required_in_proxy_mode: OpenSMN URL is required in proxy mode.

error.invalid_interval: Interval must be between 600 and 7200 seconds.
